See Rajeev et al. 2019 - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.vaccine.2018.11.011 especially table 4. In Madagascar PEP is free (via Institut Pasteur) and given by ID (but TRC not 1-week regimen yet). It is administered from just 31 centres, so patients have to travel far. Stockouts are common. 202/519 bite patients are non-exposures (so can calibrate healthy bite patients) 0.22-0.58 of bite patients are due to rabid animals; annual bite patient incidence is 189/100,000 per year BUT this includes unreported rabies exposures who do not seek/ obtain PEP. pPEP is 0.84 - you can work out bpi minus these individuals; dog populations are here: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8167587/

MIMAROPA is a rural archipelago, there is a lot of local variation in how IBCM is done. Worth chatting with Ellie - but for immediate pragmatic purposes most numbers come from Swedberg 2023 https://www.oaepublish.com/articles/ohir.2023.02 see the wider context paragraph in the discussion that usefully reports BPI for multiple Philippines provinces! I don't know what compliance is (Rysava paper worth a look, but assume it is high >0.9?). Based on experience from the Philippines, I would say that pInvestigate is VERY modifiable - if well resourced it can be >0.8, but the starting position is probably very low (<25%)! you should chat about this with Ellie and we can discuss when we meet too
